label: flutter pub get
args: 'dir=$1 root=$2 tool=$3; shift 3; [ -n "$dir" ] || dir=$root; while [ ! -f "$dir/pubspec.yaml" ] && [ "$dir" != "$root" ] && [ "$dir" != / ]; do dir=$(dirname "$dir"); done; cd "$dir" || exit; sdk=$dir; while [ ! -d "$sdk/.fvm/flutter_sdk/bin" ] && [ "$sdk" != "$root" ] && [ "$sdk" != / ]; do sdk=$(dirname "$sdk"); done; if [ -d "$sdk/.fvm/flutter_sdk/bin" ]; then tool=$sdk/.fvm/flutter_sdk/bin/$tool; fi; exec "$tool" "$@"'
